new.story: A 1990 British five pence. The side shown has Raphael Maklouf's portrait of Queen Elizabeth II with ELIZABETH II D.G.REG.F.D. 1990. The other side shows a crowned thistle, the badge of Scotland. 1990 was the first year of the smaller five pence.
new.notes: Phase 1; Muse's reading, checked by the owner with Muse; re-filed by Claude.

source: Muse photo NOID_UnitedKingdom_1990_Uncertain_obv.jpg (Drive STAGING id 1UQM8RhiDe02AW6ePsR85Z1FGbpxgXzUS), from Muse's changes_muse_20261009-2115.jsonl (GB.KM.937b, 1990); ELIZABETH II and 1990 read by Claude; about 17-18 mm against the 50.8 mm flip, the size of the 1990 small 5p; the owner said in chat on 2026-10-14 that all of Muse's new-coin photos are new coins ("I verify what they are with muse as I go"); value as C167/C168 (same type)
